CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified contents.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions), its presentation/access (explicit position set), and a separate origin/status field are all stated for the same referent.

A.rationale: No attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to a content's organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple entries explicitly identify content sets (e.g. red/blue) at named referents.

D.rationale: Origins/status fields are provided separately from content coordinate lists, distinguishing content identity from provenance/status.

O.rationale: The report states how contents are represented/presented as explicit coordinate sets for specific referents.
